verdict.rationale: Orama's only built-in AI is the AnswerSession answer engine, which gives ChatGPT-like question answering over indexed data via Secure Proxy to OpenAI. That is Q&A that developers embed in their own sites, not an in-product assistant a user hands tasks to. The MCP server and the JavaScript agent runtime let external or custom-built agents work with Orama data, so delegation needs extra tooling. Missing for 10: a native in-product assistant that can take and execute delegated tasks (e.g., in the Orama Cloud dashboard), documentation of task-level (not just Q&A) agent behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
